name: phone-signalwire
description: SignalWire for phone: Call me rings your own phone, for the same call as in the app, with its audio over your phone line. fxbot signs in to SignalWire as a softphone and connects out, and nothing reaches fxbot.

settings.name: space
settings.description: Your SignalWire space's name, as in <space>.signalwire.com

settings.name: project
settings.description: Your SignalWire project id, from API Credentials

settings.name: token
settings.description: An API token of the project with the Voice scope

settings.name: from
settings.description: Your SignalWire number calls come from, such as +15551234567
